summary_en: Interim dividend raised to ¥43.00 per share from ¥38.00; full-year dividend forecast increased to ¥86.00 per share, up ¥10.00 from prior guidance of ¥76.00.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Dividend on Surplus (Interim Dividend Increase) and Revision of Projected Year-End Dividend (Increase)
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, Seiren's Board of Directors approved an interim dividend of ¥43.00 per share for the period ending September 30, 2026, raising it by ¥5.00 from the previously forecast ¥38.00. The total interim dividend payout is ¥2,502 million, with an ex-dividend date of November 26, 2026.

Concurrently, the company revised its full-year dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The projected year-end dividend was increased to ¥43.00 per share, also up ¥5.00 from the prior guidance of ¥38.00. This brings the full-year dividend forecast to ¥86.00 per share, an increase of ¥10.00 from the previously announced target of ¥76.00.

The company stated that dividend decisions reflect its core management principle of prioritizing shareholder returns through stable, ongoing distributions, while comprehensively considering business stability and growth prospects, current earnings, financial condition, and dividend payout ratio.
